license_required.quote: an individual shall be licensed by the Board before the individual may practice registered nursing in this State

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Nursing

name.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Nursing

type.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Nursing

age_minimum.quote: Be at least 18 years old to apply for certification as a nursing assistant

moral_character_required.quote: An applicant for a license under this section shall be of good moral character

degree_required.value: diploma or degree from a registered nursing education program approved by the Board or substantially equivalent program
degree_required.quote: An applicant for a license to practice registered nursing shall complete satisfactorily and meet all requirements for a diploma or degree from: (1) A registered nursing education program approved by the Board; or (2) An education program in registered nursing in any other state or country that the Board finds substantially equivalent

exams.name: NCLEX-RN (National Council Licensure Examination for Registered Nurses)
exams.jurisdiction: national (National Council of State Boards of Nursing)
exams.quote: the applicant shall pass an examination developed by the National Council of State Boards of Nursing and administered at a testing site approved by the National Council

exams.name: Board-approved national examination for advanced practice registered nurses
exams.quote: An applicant qualifies for certification as an advanced practice registered nurse only if the applicant passes a Board–approved national examination for advanced practice registered nurses

interval_years.quote: A license expires on the 28th day of the birth month of the licensee and may not be renewed for a term longer than 2 years

period_years.quote: 1,000 hours of active nursing practice within the 5–year period immediately preceding the date of renewal

available.quote: the Board may issue a license by endorsement and waive any appropriate examination requirement of this title for an applicant who has an active unencumbered license to practice registered nursing or licensed practical nursing in any other state or country

requirements.value: Applicant must have active unencumbered license in another state/country; education must have met Maryland standards at time of graduation; applicant must have passed similar examination in another state/country; applicant must meet other qualifications required by Maryland
requirements.quote: the Board may issue a license by endorsement and waive any appropriate examination requirement of this title for an applicant who has an active unencumbered license to practice registered nursing or licensed practical nursing in any other state or country... The Board may issue a license by endorsement under this section only if the applicant... Provides adequate evidence that: (i) At the time the applicant graduated from a nursing education program approved in the other state or country, the applicant met the educational qualifications then required by the laws of this State; (ii) At the time the applicant became licensed or registered in the other state or country, the applicant passed in that or any other state or country an examination that was similar to the examination that then was given in this State; and (iii) The applicant meets the qualifications otherwise required by this title

exists.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Nursing

national_certification.value: National Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners (NBPME) for nurse practitioners; American Association of Nurse Practitioners for registered nurse practitioners; national certifying bodies recognized by the Board for advanced practice registered nurses
national_certification.quote: A certified registered nurse practitioner shall practice in accordance with the standards of practice of the American Association of Nurse Practitioners or any other national certifying body recognized by the Board

national_association.quote: A certified registered nurse practitioner shall practice in accordance with the standards of practice of the American Association of Nurse Practitioners or any other national certifying body recognized by the Board

regulatory_model.quote: an individual shall be licensed by the Board before the individual may practice registered nursing in this State

credential_type.quote: an individual shall be licensed by the Board before the individual may practice registered nursing in this State

is_mandatory.quote: an individual shall be licensed by the Board before the individual may practice registered nursing in this State

title_protection.quote: Unless authorized to practice registered nursing under this title, an individual may not use the words or terms "registered nurse", the abbreviations "R.N.", or any other title, symbol, abbreviation, sign, card, device, or other representation with the intent to represent that the individual practices registered nursing

scope_protection.quote: an individual shall be licensed by the Board before the individual may practice registered nursing in this State

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulently or deceptively obtaining or attempting to obtain a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraudulently or deceptively obtains or attempts to obtain a license for the applicant or for another

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulently or deceptively using a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraudulently or deceptively uses a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being disciplined by a licensing authority in another state or country or convicted for an act that would be grounds for disciplinary action
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is disciplined by a licensing, military, or disciplinary authority in this State or in any other state or country or convicted or disciplined by a court in this State or in any other state or country for an act that would be grounds for disciplinary action under the Board's disciplinary statutes

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of or pleading guilty to a felony or crime involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is convicted of or pleads guilty or nolo contendere to a felony or to a crime involving moral turpitude, whether or not any appeal or other proceeding is pending to have the conviction or plea set aside

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully filing false reports or records of individuals under the licensee's care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully and knowingly: (i) Files a false report or record of an individual under the licensee's care

disciplinary_grounds.description: Giving false or misleading information about a material matter in an employment application
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gives any false or misleading information about a material matter in an employment application

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to file or record health records required by law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to file or record any health record that is required by law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obstructing the filing or recording of health records required by law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obstructs the filing or recording of any health record as required by law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly performing acts that exceed the scope of practice authorized
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly does any act that has been determined by the Board, in its rules and regulations, to exceed the scope of practice authorized to the individual under this title

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing professional services while under the influence of alcohol or controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Provides professional services while: (i) Under the influence of alcohol; or (ii) Using any narcotic or controlled dangerous substance, as defined in § 5–101 of the Criminal Law Article, or other drug that is in excess of therapeutic amounts or without valid medical indication

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting inconsistently with generally accepted professional standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Does an act that is inconsistent with generally accepted professional standards in the practice of registered nursing or licensed practical nursing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being grossly negligent in the practice of nursing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is grossly negligent in the practice of registered nursing or licensed practical nursing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of the nursing statute
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated any provision of this title

disciplinary_grounds.description: Submitting a false statement to collect a fee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Submits a false statement to collect a fee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being physically or mentally incompetent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is physically or mentally incompetent

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly failing to report suspected child abuse
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly fails to report suspected child abuse in violation of § 5–704 of the Family Law Article

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing or discriminating against individuals with regard to professional services because they are HIV positive
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refuses, withholds from, denies, or discriminates against an individual with regard to the provision of professional services for which the licensee is licensed and qualified to render because the individual is HIV positive

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with CDC guidelines on universal precautions except in emergency situations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Except in an emergency life–threatening situation where it is not feasible or practicable, fails to comply with the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention's guidelines on universal precautions

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to display required notice when in independent practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is in independent practice and fails to display the notice required under § 8–506 of this title

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being in breach of a service obligation from receipt of State or federal funding for nursing education
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is in breach of a service obligation resulting from the applicant's or licensee's receipt of State or federal funding for the applicant's or licensee's nursing education

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a substance use disorder
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has a substance use disorder

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being addicted to or habitually abusing narcotic or controlled dangerous substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is addicted to, or habitually abuses, any narcotic or controlled dangerous substance as defined in § 5–101 of the Criminal Law Article

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to cooperate with a lawful investigation conducted by the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to cooperate with a lawful investigation conducted by the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being expelled from the safe practice program for failure to comply with conditions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is expelled from the safe practice program established pursuant to § 8–208 of this title for failure to comply with the conditions of the program

disciplinary_grounds.description: Delegating nursing acts to individuals lacking ability or knowledge to perform them
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Delegates nursing acts or responsibilities to an individual that the applicant or licensee knows or has reason to know lacks the ability or knowledge to perform

disciplinary_grounds.description: Delegating to unlicensed individuals acts that must be performed only by licensed nurses
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Delegates to an unlicensed individual nursing acts or responsibilities the applicant or licensee knows or has reason to know are to be performed only by a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to properly supervise individuals to whom nursing acts have been delegated
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to properly supervise individuals to whom nursing acts or responsibilities have been delegated

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in conduct that violates the professional code of ethics
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engages in conduct that violates the professional code of ethics

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being professionally incompetent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is professionally incompetent

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing nursing without a license before obtaining or renewing a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practices registered nursing or licensed practical nursing without a license before obtaining or renewing a license, including any period when practicing registered nursing or licensed practical nursing on an expired license or a lapsed license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing acts that would be grounds for discipline while holding an expired or lapsed license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: When holding an expired license or a lapsed license or after a temporary license has expired in accordance with § 8–315(c) of this subtitle, commits any act that would be grounds for disciplinary action under this section

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing nursing on a nonrenewed license for 16 months or longer
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practices registered nursing or licensed practical nursing on a nonrenewed license for a period of 16 months or longer

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating regulations adopted by the Board or an order from the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violates regulations adopted by the Board or an order from the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing acts that are beyond the licensee's knowledge and skills
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performs an act that is beyond the licensee's knowledge and skills

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to submit to a criminal history records check
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to submit to a criminal history records check in accordance with § 8–303 of this subtitle

disciplinary_grounds.description: When acting in supervisory position, directing another nurse to perform acts beyond their knowledge and skills
disciplinary_grounds.quote: When acting in a supervisory position, directs another nurse to perform an act that is beyond the nurse's knowledge and skills

disciplinary_grounds.description: When acting in supervisory position, directing another nurse to delegate tasks when nurse lacks knowledge/skills or patient condition does not allow delegation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: When acting in a supervisory position, directs another nurse to delegate a nursing task to an individual when that nurse reasonably believes: (i) The individual lacks the knowledge and skills to perform the task; or (ii) The patient's condition does not allow delegation of the nursing task

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misappropriating the property of a patient or a facility
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has misappropriated the property of a patient or a facility

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with statutory limits on opioid prescribing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to comply with § 1–223 of this article

definition_quote.value: Practice registered nursing means the performance of acts requiring substantial specialized knowledge, judgment, and skill based on the biological, physiological, behavioral, or sociological sciences as the basis for assessment, nursing diagnosis, planning, implementation, and evaluation of the practice of nursing in order to: (i) Maintain health; (ii) Prevent illness; or (iii) Care for or rehabilitate the ill, injured, or infirm
definition_quote.quote: "Practice registered nursing" means the performance of acts requiring substantial specialized knowledge, judgment, and skill based on the biological, physiological, behavioral, or sociological sciences as the basis for assessment, nursing diagnosis, planning, implementation, and evaluation of the practice of nursing in order to: (i) Maintain health; (ii) Prevent illness; or (iii) Care for or rehabilitate the ill, injured, or infirm

value: Supervision, delegation, and evaluation of nursing practice
Execution of therapeutic regimen, including the administration of medication and treatment
Independent nursing functions and delegated medical functions
Performance of additional acts authorized by the Board
methods_authorized.quote: For these purposes, "practice registered nursing" includes: (i) Administration; (ii) Teaching; (iii) Counseling; (iv) Supervision, delegation, and evaluation of nursing practice; (v) Execution of therapeutic regimen, including the administration of medication and treatment; (vi) Independent nursing functions and delegated medical functions; and (vii) Performance of additional acts authorized by the Board under § 8–205 of this title

drug_authority.value: Nurse practitioners may prescribe drugs as provided under § 8-508; nurse anesthetists may prescribe drugs under certain conditions; nurse midwives may prescribe substances commonly used in midwifery including controlled substances on Schedules II-V
drug_authority.quote: Prescribe drugs as provided under § 8–508 of this title

value: Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN) - including Nurse Practitioner, Nurse Anesthetist, Nurse Midwife, Clinical Nurse Specialist
license_tiers.quote: "License" means, unless the context requires otherwise, a license issued by the Board to practice: (1) Registered nursing; (2) Licensed practical nursing; or (3) Advanced practice registered nursing

aprn_role_categories.quote: Is certified by the Board to practice as: (i) A nurse practitioner; (ii) A nurse anesthetist; (iii) A nurse midwife; or (iv) A clinical nurse specialist

value: Licensed Practical Nurse must practice in a team relationship with at least one licensed health professional who is not a licensed practical nurse
lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: Except as provided in the rules and regulations of the Board adopted under § 8-205 of this title, a licensed practical nurse may practice licensed practical nursing only in a team relationship with at least one licensed health professional who is not a licensed practical nurse

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: This section may not be construed to require a written collaboration agreement between a nurse anesthetist and an anesthesiologist, a physician, or a dentist

full_independent_practice_available.quote: "Practice as a registered nurse practitioner" means to independently: (1) Perform an act under subsection (o) of this section; (2) Conduct a comprehensive physical assessment of an individual; (3) Establish a medical diagnosis for common chronic stable or short–term health problems; (4) Order, perform, and interpret laboratory tests; (5) Prescribe drugs as provided under § 8–508 of this title; (6) Perform diagnostic, therapeutic, or corrective measures; (7) Consult and collaborate with, or refer an individual to, an appropriate licensed physician or any other health care provider as needed; and (8) Provide emergency care

full_independent_practice_experience_hou.quote: An applicant for initial certification as a registered nurse practitioner who has not been certified by the Board or any other board of nursing shall identify on the application for certification a mentor who will consult and collaborate with the applicant for 18 months beginning on the date the application for certification is received by the Board

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: Is certified by the Board to practice as a registered nurse practitioner

value: Nurse practitioners may prescribe drugs as authorized under § 8-508
Nurse midwives may prescribe controlled substances on Schedules II, III, IV, and V commonly used in midwifery
Nurse anesthetists may prescribe drugs including controlled dangerous substances
controlled_substance_schedule_authority.quote: A nurse practitioner or midwife may personally prepare and dispense a starter dosage of any drug the nurse practitioner or midwife is authorized to prescribe

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: Lowest effective dose; quantity no greater than needed for expected duration of pain, except for substance-related disorders, cancer pain, end-of-life/hospice/palliative care, or chronic pain
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: On treatment for pain, a health care provider, based on the clinical judgment of the health care provider, shall prescribe: (1) The lowest effective dose of an opioid; and (2) A quantity that is no greater than the quantity needed for the expected duration of pain severe enough to require an opioid that is a controlled dangerous substance unless the opioid is prescribed to treat: (i) A substance–related disorder; (ii) Pain associated with a cancer diagnosis; (iii) Pain experienced while the patient is receiving end–of–life, hospice, or palliative care services; or (iv) Chronic pain

dea_registration_required.quote: A nurse anesthetist may prescribe drugs under paragraph (1) of this subsection: (i) Only in an amount that does not exceed a 10–day supply; (ii) Only for an individual with whom the nurse anesthetist has, at the time of prescription, established a client or patient record; and (iii) Only in connection with the delivery of anesthesia services

nurse_aide_registry_maintained.quote: To maintain a nurse aide registry that complies with federal law

medication_assistant_certification_avail.quote: "Certified medicine aide" means a certified nursing assistant who: (1) Has completed a Board–approved course in medication administration; and (2) Is certified as a medicine aide by the Board

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: This section does not preclude a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse from delegating a nursing or other technical task to an unlicensed individual if acceptance of delegated nursing or other technical tasks does not become a routine part of the unlicensed individual's job duties

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: A registered nurse or licensed practical nurse in a party state to the Nurse Multistate Licensure Compact shall hold a license in only one party state at a time, that is issued by the home state in accordance with Subtitle 7A of this title

multistate_license_option_available.quote: A registered nurse who has been granted multistate licensing privileges by a party state to the Nurse Multistate Licensure Compact set forth in Subtitle 7A of this title may practice registered nursing in the State

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: There is a Safe Practice Committee in the Board

nurse_practitioner_transition_to_practic.quote: An applicant for initial certification as a registered nurse practitioner who has not been certified by the Board or any other board of nursing shall identify on the application for certification a mentor who will consult and collaborate with the applicant for 18 months beginning on the date the application for certification is received by the Board

crna_physician_supervision_model.quote: An anesthesiologist, a licensed physician, or a dentist shall be physically available to the nurse anesthetist for consultation at all times during the administration of, and recovery from, anesthesia

military_education_credit_required.quote: Each unit shall credit any training and education provided by the military and completed by a service member toward any training or education requirements for licensure if the training or education is determined by the unit to be: (1) substantially equivalent to the training or education required by the unit; and (2) not otherwise contrary to any other licensing requirement
